_comment: Expected NetlistDiff result for comparing baseline.v vs comparison.v through the Pro v1 ProNetlistDiffService (exactNameMatch). The shape mirrors NetlistDiff.toJson(); the integration test in test/features/diff/diff_integration_test.dart asserts a subset of these fields against a synthetic in-memory equivalent of the same netlists (running Yosys in unit tests is out of scope). When verifying the full pipeline end-to-end during a release sign-off, load both .v files through Tools → Load Comparison Netlist…, then check that the panel summary matches the counts here.
_liveVerificationNote: The instance/module counts and all four original expectedRows below were already accurate (diff_integration_test.dart's synthetic single-module fixture happened to exercise them). The `port` summary was NOT — it silently assumed the diff only walks top's 3 ports. Corrected 2026-07-19 while wiring test/fixtures/diff_netlist_fixture_sync_test.dart (verification/fixtures/diff/{baseline,comparison}.netlist.json, the first fixture pair to model the real 3-module hierarchy top+u_alu+u_dma): ProNetlistDiffService._diffPerModule walks EVERY module name in the union of both sides, including a wholly-new module like u_dma — so u_dma's own 2 ports (clk, data) surface as `added` port rows too, not just top's in_a width change. Added a `net` summary section for the same reason (previously omitted, not previously wrong — the original _comment already disclaimed this as a subset).

summary._comment: Per-elementKind counts. Yosys may emit synthesised cells beyond the explicit instance set (e.g. $reduce_xor for the ^a expression); the integration test asserts only the listed expected categories.

port._note: unchanged=5: top.in_clk, top.out_y, u_alu.a, u_alu.clk, u_alu.y. added=2: u_dma.clk, u_dma.data (see _liveVerificationNote).

net._note: Same shape as port: added=2 is u_dma:net:clk / u_dma:net:data.

expectedRows._note: New module's own ports surface as added rows too — see _liveVerificationNote.
